name: Wood County, Ohio (United States)
description: Blue field charged with a gold map of Ohio bearing the county in red with the date 1820, surrounded by nineteen white stars for the townships, over a red ribbon reading WOOD COUNTY.
history: Wood County is a county located in Ohio. The flag was adopted on 1 May 2002 (adopted by the Wood County Commissioners on 1 May 2002 at the request of the Ohio Bicentennial Commission, designed by the Buildings and Grounds Committee, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: map of Ohio with the county in red and the date 1820
